LANDED. Change 1056 submitted at 19:50:50; merged to main as 2c23b0d6b (Gerrit rebased it server-side from the pushed 020038055). Gates: LLM-Review+1 19:33:12, Verified+1 19:49:16, 0 unresolved comments, all submit requirements SATISFIED.

IMPORTANT finding for anyone measuring a CI-workflow change on this project: the Verified gate CANNOT exercise a change to the workflow files themselves.

I tried to measure the speedup on this change's own Verified run (30574548545) and got 15.9m for the macOS default-suite step against a 15.4m baseline — i.e. no improvement. The reason is not the change. Dumping the command line actually executed on the macOS runner in that run shows:

  pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 3 --dist worksteal -q -p no:cacheprovider --durations=25 --basetemp=... --cov=rebar --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered

The --cov flags are still there. gerrit-verify.yaml invokes this reusable as 'uses: ./.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml', and under workflow_dispatch GitHub resolves a './' reusable from the DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the patchset — the patchset is only checked out INSIDE each job by checkout-gerrit-change-action. gerrit-verify.yaml already documents this for a different reason (the vote job's comment: 'workflow_dispatch runs this workflow's definition from main, so main is also where the trusted script lives').

Consequence: for any change to .github/workflows/**, the Verified vote proves the change does not break the SOURCE tree, but it never runs the modified workflow. Post-merge observation on test.yml / the next Verified run is the only measurement. Do not read a flat pre-merge number as evidence that a workflow change did nothing.

Also note the pass count moved 7856 -> 7873 between the baseline run and this one (other changes landed in between), so cross-run step comparisons carry that noise regardless.

Revised expected size: an independent measurement of coverage.py overhead on this suite came in at +5.1% (61.5s -> 64.7s at -n 3 on a subset), so the honest expectation is ~0.8 min off an ~18.6m macOS job, not a large win. Still free and still correct — the ubuntu cells enforce the identical floor over the identical selection — but it is a small lever, and I had initially implied it was bigger.

Verification to do post-merge (next Verified run after the mirror catches up): confirm the macOS pytest command no longer contains --cov, that the macOS log prints no coverage report, that the pass count is unchanged, and that the three ubuntu cells still print theirs.
